planning_warnings.rationale: Three instructional modules, three formative checkpoints, and one integrated summative are allocated within a 60-minute total. Per-module estimates are provisional and may be insufficient for lower-ability learners or if formative feedback cycles extend beyond planned task time. mod-fr-02 precedes mod-fr-03 because obj-fr-03 carries both obj-fr-01 and obj-fr-02 as explicit prerequisites: learners must be able to produce a complete report before cross-referencing it against the source ledger to identify discrepancies.

mod-fr-sum follows all three instructional modules so that the integrated summative task (asmt-fr-sum) can sample all three objective domains in a single performance after instruction and formative practice are complete.
